name: Topic 33: Water from food and drinks (tea, coffee, coconut water, buttermilk)
defaultTargetFormula: No separate target. Uses Topic 30 drinks target (male 2500 ml, female 2000 ml, est.). Logged drink counts_as_water_pct x ml. Rules (est.): plain water, unsweetened tea/coffee, milk, chaas, tender coconut water, lemon water with free sugar <= 8 g/100 ml = 100%; first 4 tea/coffee cups = 100%, beyond 4 cups = 50%; drinks with free sugar > 8 g/100 ml (sugarcane juice, packaged juice, soft drinks) = 50%; alcohol = 0%. Food water (about 20% of total water, NASEM/Mayo secondary) is shown as information only and is not added to the goal. ICMR-NIN 2020 water values Not found.

drinks.name: Chai (milk tea, up to 2 tsp sugar)
drinks.notes: est.; 120 ml; caffeine 30-65 mg per cup (secondary); about 8-10 g sugar; sodium about 10 mg, potassium about 45 mg (est.); more than 2 tsp sugar counts 50%

drinks.name: Black or green tea, no sugar
drinks.notes: est.; 150 ml; caffeine 30-65 mg (secondary); first 4 tea/coffee cups full

drinks.name: Filter coffee with milk
drinks.notes: est.; 100-150 ml; caffeine 80-120 mg per 150 ml brewed (secondary); beyond 4 cups counts 50%

drinks.name: Milk, whole cow
drinks.notes: 200 ml; IFCT 2017 water 86.64%, sodium 25.4 mg/100 g, potassium 115 mg/100 g; BHI about 1.5 (Maughan 2016)

drinks.name: Chaas (salted buttermilk)
drinks.notes: est.; 200 ml; sodium about 170 mg and potassium about 284 mg (secondary, unverified); sodium varies with salt (Topic 18)

drinks.name: Sweet lassi
drinks.notes: est.; 200 ml; about 16-20 g sugar (est.); sodium 50-80 mg/100 ml (secondary, unverified); counts 50% if free sugar above 8 g/100 ml

drinks.name: Tender coconut water
drinks.notes: 200 ml; IFCT 2017 water 95.77%, potassium 215 mg/100 g, sodium 28 mg/100 g, carbohydrate 3.16 g/100 g; kidney and potassium-medicine users need doctor advice (Topic 19)

drinks.name: Nimbu pani (homemade)
drinks.notes: est.; 250 ml; about 8-10 g sugar and about 200 mg sodium (est.); reduce sugar and salt

drinks.name: Sugarcane juice
drinks.notes: est., product policy; 200 ml; IFCT 2017 water 85.54%, 13.1 g carbohydrate/100 g, about 26 g sugar per glass; ICMR-NIN 2024 says minimise (secondary)

drinks.name: Fresh fruit juice, no added sugar
drinks.notes: est.; 150 ml; prefer whole fruit; ICMR-NIN 2024: use 100-150 g fruit (secondary)

drinks.name: Packaged fruit juice
drinks.notes: est., product policy; 150-200 ml; about 10 g sugar/100 ml (est.); WHO counts juice sugar as free sugar

drinks.name: Soft drink or cola
drinks.notes: est., product policy; 250-330 ml; about 10.6 g sugar/100 ml (est.); cola caffeine about 40 mg per 355 ml (EUFIC); ICMR-NIN: not a substitute for water (secondary)

drinks.name: ORS (WHO)
drinks.notes: For diarrhoea, vomiting or heat illness only; 75 mmol/L sodium (about 172 mg/100 ml, calc.), 75 mmol/L glucose; follow sachet label

drinks.name: Sports or electrolyte drink
drinks.notes: est.; use label; only for long or very sweaty sessions; 50% if sugar above 8 g/100 ml

drinks.name: Alcohol
drinks.notes: Not counted; higher-strength alcohol raises urine output

reminderRules.rule: Use Topic 30 reminders (up to 6 per day, 09:30 to 19:30, skip if a drink was logged in the last 60 minutes, none after 21:00)
After 3 tea/coffee logs in a day, suggest water or chaas for the next reminder
reminderRules.source: FitPlate design (est.); ICMR-NIN 2024 caffeine about 300 mg/day (news summary, secondary, unverified); EFSA 2015 400 mg/day

reminderRules.rule: No tea/coffee prompts within 1 hour of meals for users flagged iron-deficient
Doctor-flag users (kidney, heart, liver, fluid limit, diuretics, diabetes needing sugar limits): no hydration reminders and no coconut-water or ORS suggestions; show 'Follow your doctor's advice'
reminderRules.source: FitPlate safety design; Topic 18, 19 and 30 convention

warnings: Food water is a cushion (about 20% of total water, secondary); the app goal counts logged drinks only.
Caffeine: about 300 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2024, news summary, secondary, unverified); EFSA 2015: 400 mg/day, 200 mg/day in pregnancy.
Drinks with more than 8 g free sugar per 100 ml count at 50% (est., product policy); WHO: free sugars under 10% of energy, ideally under 5% (about 25 g/day).
Tender coconut water is potassium-rich (IFCT 2017: 215 mg/100 g); users with kidney disease or on potassium-affecting medicines need doctor advice.
Salted chaas, nimbu pani and ORS add sodium; count toward Topic 18 and ask a doctor if you have hypertension, heart or kidney disease.
ICMR-NIN 2020 water values Not found; ICMR-NIN 2024 content is from news summaries (secondary, unverified).
IFCT 2017 has no values for curd, chaas, lassi or cooked dishes; those numbers are est. or secondary.
